source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 9.5.3 (PDF 219), rewritten 2026-10-27 to follow the book paragraph for paragraph.

blocks.text: Kabhi kabhi karobar ko maujood paise se zyada raqam chahiye hoti hai, to woh bank ya kisi aur financial institution (paise ka idara) se loan (qarz) leta hai. Loan udhaar liya hua paisa hai jo interest (sood) ke saath wapas karna hota hai. Interest paisa udhaar lene ki qeemat hai, jo aam taur par loan ki raqam ke percentage (feesad) mein batayi jati hai.
Misal: agar Multan ka ek chai khana Rs. 100,000 ka loan 10% har saal ke interest par leta hai, to ek saal baad use Rs. 110,000 wapas karne honge:

blocks.text_alt: Total Repayment = Loan Amount + Interest = 100,000 + 10% × 100,000 = Rs. 110,000

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text: Rs. 50,000 ke loan par ek saal ke liye 8% interest ho to kul kitni raqam wapas karni hogi? Dekhein ke interest rate kul wapsi ki raqam par kaise asar dalta hai.

Yeh program loan ka interest aur ek saal baad ki kul wapsi nikalta hai. Class Activity ke liye loan_amount = 50000 aur interest_rate = 8 kar ke Run karein, phir rate badal kar dekhein ke kul wapsi kaise badalti hai.

loan_amount = 100000     # Rs.
interest_rate = 10       # feesad (percent) har saal

interest = loan_amount * interest_rate / 100
total_repayment = loan_amount + interest
print(f"Interest: Rs. {interest:,.0f}")
print(f"Ek saal baad kul wapsi: Rs. {total_repayment:,.0f}")

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"loan_amount = 100000" aur "interest_rate = 10": qarz (loan) ki raqam aur saalana interest (sood) feesad mein.
"interest = loan_amount * interest_rate / 100": 100,000 ka 10% = 10,000.
"total_repayment = loan_amount + interest": ek saal baad kul wapsi = 100,000 + 10,000 = 110,000.
"{interest:,.0f}": "/" ki wajah se interest decimal number hai; ",.0f" comma lagata hai aur decimal hissa nahi dikhata.
Output: "Interest: Rs. 10,000" aur "Ek saal baad kul wapsi: Rs. 110,000".
Khud try karein: Class Activity ke liye loan_amount = 50000 aur interest_rate = 8 kar ke Run karein: "Interest: Rs. 4,000" aur kul wapsi "Rs. 54,000" aayegi.

blocks.prompt: Class Activity: Rs. 50,000 ka loan ek saal ke liye 8% interest par ho to kul kitna wapas karna hoga? Interest rate kul raqam par kaise asar dalta hai?
blocks.explanation: Interest = 8% × 50,000 = Rs. 4,000, is liye kul wapsi = 50,000 + 4,000 = Rs. 54,000. Interest rate jitna zyada ho, interest utna hi zyada banta hai: 10% par yahi loan Rs. 55,000 wapas hota.

blocks.prompt: Karobar mein financial management (paise ka intezam) ki ahmiyat samjhaiye. Budget aur cash flow karobar ke kaam par kaise asar dalte hain (long question 6)?
blocks.explanation: Financial management karobar ko chalta rakhta hai: profit bachane ke liye revenue aur kharchon ka hisab, budget se kharchon ka plan, saaman aur achanak kharchon ke liye savings, aur yeh faisla ke loan kab lena faidamand hai. Budget batata hai ke paisa kahan kharch hona chahiye aur zyada kharch (overspending) se khabardar karta hai. Cash flow, yaani paisa kab aata aur kab jata hai, is liye zaroori hai ke munafa kamane wala karobar bhi doob sakta hai agar kiraya aur tankhwahein waqt par ada na kar sake; cash flow ka plan is kami se bachata hai. Chapter cash flow ko nahi samjhata; yeh hissa aam maloomat se hai.
